goal: Help a budget owner record daily spending, understand the month, and correct mistakes without decorative content displacing the work.

requirements.description: Daily spending exposes a first-viewport Add expense entry point, while the form makes amount, merchant, category, date, note, validation, cancellation, and correction visible.
Expense rows expose edit and delete actions and the deletion path includes specific confirmation plus an undo recovery state.
The expense collection covers empty, one-item, typical, 25-item dense, long-content, and missing-optional-content states with consistent actions.
The monthly summary groups spending by category and exposes multiple nested expenses, unusually formatted values, and drill-in controls.
Dense and long states retain readable hierarchy, wrap long labels, preserve large and negative values, and keep task controls discoverable on compact devices.
Primary task data and actions occupy the first viewport before any low-value decoration across the complete delivery set.
